product.subject: White Grey Breathable Knit Lace-Up Walking Shoes Lightweight EVA Casual Sneakers M8811 BQ006

product_faq.question: Are you a factory or a trading company?
product_faq.answer: We are a footwear factory located in Quanzhou, Fujian, China. We supply casual walking shoes and related footwear for overseas B2B buyers. Product details and order requirements are confirmed according to the current style.

product_faq.question: What is your MOQ?
product_faq.answer: For available styles, small trial orders can be discussed. We support mixed colors and mixed sizes to help buyers test the market. For customized orders, MOQ depends on logo, packaging and material requirements.

product_faq.question: Can I mix different colors and sizes in one order?
product_faq.answer: Yes. Mixed colors and mixed sizes are supported for available styles. Mixed styles can also be discussed according to stock and order quantity.

product_faq.question: Can I order samples before bulk order?
product_faq.answer: Yes. Samples can be arranged for quality checking. The sample fee, courier cost, development time and any bulk-order policy will be confirmed for the current style before payment.

product_faq.question: Do you support customized packaging?
product_faq.answer: Yes. Standard packaging can be shoe box or plastic bag. For large orders, customized packaging such as custom shoe box, label or packing method can be discussed.

product_faq.question: Do you support logo or product customization?
product_faq.answer: Logo, color, size ratio and packaging customization can be discussed. Please send your design, target quantity and market requirements, and we will check the production solution for you.

product_faq.question: How long is the delivery time?
product_faq.answer: Delivery time depends on stock, order quantity and customization requirements. Available styles can usually be arranged faster, while customized or bulk production needs to be confirmed before order.

product_faq.question: Why choose your factory?
product_faq.answer: We provide factory support for product confirmation, sample checking, mixed size and color discussion, packing requirements and OEM/ODM cooperation. Final specifications are confirmed according to the current style and order details.

struct_detail.product_summary: Breathable knit lace-up walking shoes for importers, wholesalers, online sellers and private-label buyers. Seven source-verified colors are available. Main colors cover EU 35-45; White Pink and White Purple cover EU 35-40, for 67 actual color-size combinations. Custom logo, color and packaging requirements can be discussed after order review. Final quotation and timing depend on quantity, size ratio and packing.
